title_en: As IDW's Sonic the Hedgehog Comic Nears Issue #100, the Publisher Kicks Off 'Road to #100' Initiative
summary_en: IDW's long-running Sonic the Hedgehog series will reach issue #100 next year, and the publisher is celebrating with the 'Road to #100' initiative.
body_en:
IDW Publishing will be celebrating a major milestone in 2027, as the long-running Sonic the Hedgehog comic reaches issue #100. The publisher is already teasing the big developments to come with a new promotion called 'Road to #100.'
That push begins in earnest with Sonic the Hedgehog #94, which kicks off a new storyline focused on Surge and Kit. IGN can exclusively debut the cover art for issue #94 below:
Sonic the Hedgehog #94 is written by Daniel Barnes and Evan Stanley and drawn by Alex Forrest. Here's the official solicitation text for that issue:
Sonic the Hedgehog #94 will hit stores in March 2027. As an added bonus, we can also debut a new preview of issue #91 (due out on October 28) in the slideshow gallery below:
You can preorder both books at your local comic shop .
This isn't the only big news out of IDW. IGN also revealed that the publisher is gearing up for the first big crossover event of the Kai-Sei line, Godzilla Versus Everything . And at NYCC, IDW revealed that they've tapped Grant Morrison to write a new James Bond comic .
